title: PolyShape tool and Bezier shape tool

sections.heading: POLYSHAPE
sections.content:
The PolyShape subsystem provides interactive creation and extrusion of arbitrary 2D polygon perimeters into 3D meshes. It is implemented across runtime component `PolyShape`, interactive editor tool `DrawPolyShapeTool` / `PolyShapeTool`, and custom inspector `PolyShapeEditor`.

1. Component Architecture & Data Model:
- Class `PolyShape : MonoBehaviour` is decorated with `[AddComponentMenu("")]`, `[DisallowMultipleComponent]`, `[ExcludeFromPreset, ExcludeFromObjectFactory]`, `[Icon(k_IconPath)]`, and `[ProGridsConditionalSnap]`.
- State enum `PolyShape.PolyEditMode`: defines lifecycle modes `None` (idle/finalized), `Path` (initial point placement), `Height` (interactive extrusion dragging), and `Edit` (modifying points on an existing shape).
- Serialized fields: `m_Points` (`List<Vector3>`, serialized as `points`), `m_Extrude` (`float`, default `0f`), `m_EditMode` (`PolyEditMode`), `m_FlipNormals` (`bool`), and `isOnGrid` (`bool`, default `true`).
- Public properties: `controlPoints` (`ReadOnlyCollection<Vector3>`), `extrude` (`float`), `flipNormals` (`bool`), and `mesh` (`ProBuilderMesh`, lazily fetched via `GetComponent<ProBuilderMesh>()`). Method `SetControlPoints(IList<Vector3> points)` populates `m_Points`.

2. Tool Activation & Initialization UX:
- Menu item `Tools/ProBuilder/Editors/Create PolyShape` invokes `ToolManager.SetActiveTool<DrawPolyShapeTool>()` and sends analytics event `ProBuilderAnalytics.SendActionEvent("New PolyShape", nameof(DrawPolyShapeTool))`.
- In `DrawPolyShapeTool.OnActivated()`, selection is cleared via `MeshSelection.SetSelection((GameObject)null)`, active context is set to `ToolManager.SetActiveContext<GameObjectToolContext>()`, and base initialization establishes undo group `m_UndoGroup = Undo.GetCurrentGroup()`.
- Tool lifecycle method `TryCreatePolyShape()` checks `CanCreateNewPolyShape()` (verifying all inspector windows are unlocked), creates a temporary GameObject `go = new GameObject("PolyShape")` with `HideFlags.HideAndDontSave | HideFlags.HideInInspector`, adds `PolyShape` and `ProBuilderMesh` components via `Undo.AddComponent`, executes initial `pb.CreateShapeFromPolygon(m_PolyShape.m_Points, m_PolyShape.extrude, m_PolyShape.flipNormals)`, sets `polyEditMode = PolyShape.PolyEditMode.Path`, and positions the GameObject at the active ProGrids pivot if snapping or grid display is active.

3. Input Plane Resolution (`SetupInputPlane`):
- When placing the first point, `SetupInputPlane(Vector2 mousePosition)` calls `EditorHandleUtility.FindBestPlane(mousePosition)` to establish drawing plane `m_Plane` (`UnityEngine.Plane`). Priority sequence: (1) raycasting against picked meshes in scene via `GetPlaneFromPickedObject`, (2) ProGrids active grid axis via `GetPlaneFromProGridsAxis`, (3) SceneView camera view plane via `GetPlaneFromSceneView()`.
- Grid alignment verification: if `Math.IsCardinalAxis(plane.normal)`, checks whether plane center `plane.normal * -plane.distance` aligns with `EditorSnapping.activeMoveSnapValue` within tolerance `epsilon = .00001f`, setting `polygon.isOnGrid = !offGrid`.

4. Point Placement UX Loop (`DoPointPlacement` in `PolyEditMode.Path`):
- Cursor states: `MouseCursor.ArrowPlus` when hovering over the input plane ready to place points, `MouseCursor.MoveArrow` while actively dragging or holding hot controls.
- Mouse click handling: on `EventType.MouseDown` (button 0):
  - First point: sets GameObject transform position `polygon.transform.position = GetPointFromHit(hit)`. Calculates camera-facing normal `cameraFacingPlaneNormal = plane.normal` (inverted if `Vector3.Dot(cameraFacingPlaneNormal, camera.forward) > 0f`), and sets rotation `polygon.transform.rotation = Quaternion.LookRotation(cameraFacingPlaneNormal) * Quaternion.Euler(new Vector3(90f, 0f, 0f))`.
  - Subsequent points: projects world hit into local space via `GetPointInLocalSpace(hit)`, applying `ProBuilderSnapping.GetSnappingMaskBasedOnNormalVector(plane.normal)` and `EditorSnapping.activeMoveSnapValue` when `polygon.isOnGrid` is enabled.
  - Appends coordinate to `polygon.m_Points.Add(point)`, activates dragging state `m_PlacingPoint = true`, sets selected index `m_SelectedIndex = polygon.m_Points.Count - 1`, and triggers mesh rebuild `RebuildPolyShapeMesh(polygon)`.
  - While dragging (`EventType.MouseDrag` with `m_PlacingPoint == true`), continually raycasts against `plane` to update `polygon.m_Points[m_SelectedIndex]` and repaints SceneView.
- Dynamic preview rendering: `DoExistingLinesGUI()` calls `DrawPolyLine()` to render blue lines (`k_LineColor = Color(0f, 55f / 255f, 1f, 1f)`) between placed points, and `DrawGuideLine()` to render dotted line `Handles.DrawDottedLine` (`k_DrawingLineColor = Color(0.01f, .9f, 0.3f, 1f)`) from last placed point to current cursor position `m_CurrentPosition`.

5. Closing Polygon & Advancing Mode:
- Loop closing condition: if cursor clicks near point 0 (`Math.Approx3(polygon.m_Points[0], point)` or hovers control `m_ControlId0` when `polygon.m_Points.Count > 2`), sets `m_NextMouseUpAdvancesMode = true`. Alternatively, pressing `KeyCode.Return` or `KeyCode.Space` advances the mode if `m_Points.Count > 2`.
- Upon mouse up, `OnToolGUI` consumes event and calls `SetPolyEditMode(PolyShape.PolyEditMode.Height)`.

6. Extrusion Height Adjustment UX (`PolyEditMode.Height`):
- Entering Height mode initializes mouse offset: calculates origin `origin = polygon.transform.TransformPoint(Math.Average(polygon.m_Points))`. Checks `SceneCameraIsAlignedWithPolyUp()` (`Mathf.Abs(Mathf.Abs(Vector3.Dot(camera.forward, polygon.transform.up)) - 1f) < .01f`). If camera is looking directly along up vector, sets `s_HeightMouseOffset = polygon.extrude` and finalizes immediately to prevent coplanar raycasting degeneracies.
- Otherwise, projects mouse ray against extrusion line using `Math.GetNearestPointRayRay(origin, up, r.origin, r.direction)`, computing `s_HeightMouseOffset = polygon.extrude - EditorSnapping.MoveSnap(extrude)`.
- In `DoExistingPointsGUI()` for `Height` mode: on `EventType.MouseMove`, evaluates ray-ray intersection point `p`, computing `extrude = EditorSnapping.MoveSnap(s_HeightMouseOffset + Vector3.Distance(origin, p) * Mathf.Sign(Vector3.Dot(p - origin, up)))`.
- Renders handle visualization: bottom dot `Handles.DotHandleCap` at `origin` (`k_HandleColor`), vertical line `Handles.DrawLine(origin, extrudePoint)` (`k_HandleColorGreen`), and top cap dot `Handles.DotHandleCap` at `extrudePoint` (`k_HandleColorGreen`).
- Finalizing shape: on MouseUp (button 0), Return, or Space key, calls `TryFinalizeShape()`: records `Undo.RegisterCreatedObjectUndo(polygon.gameObject, "Finalize Draw PolyShape")`, clears `HideFlags.None`, collapses undo operations via `Undo.CollapseUndoOperations(m_UndoGroup)`, and sets `polygon = null`.

7. Normal Computation for Non-Planar Point Sets:
- When a polygon's vertices are not strictly coplanar, face normal calculation is handled during triangulation and mesh rebuilding by `Math.Normal(ProBuilderMesh mesh, Face face)` and `Projection.FindBestPlane(IList<Vector3> points, IList<int> indexes)`.
- For polygons with more than 6 index entries (> 2 triangles), `Math.Normal` computes the Newell plane normal using covariance analysis in `Projection.FindBestPlane`.
- Algorithm: computes 3D centroid `c = sum(points) / len`, centered offsets `r = point - c`, and covariance matrix components: `xx = sum(r.x^2)`, `xy = sum(r.x * r.y)`, `xz = sum(r.x * r.z)`, `yy = sum(r.y^2)`, `yz = sum(r.y * r.z)`, `zz = sum(r.z^2)`.
- Evaluates principal determinants: `det_x = yy * zz - yz * yz`, `det_y = xx * zz - xz * xz`, `det_z = xx * yy - xy * xy`.
- Extracts dominant eigenvector: if `det_x` is greatest, `n = Vector3(1f, (xz * yz - xy * zz) / det_x, (xy * yz - xz * yy) / det_x)`; if `det_y` is greatest, `n = Vector3((yz * xz - xy * zz) / det_y, 1f, (xy * xz - yz * xx) / det_y)`; otherwise `n = Vector3((yz * xy - xz * yy) / det_z, (xz * xy - yz * xx) / det_z, 1f)`. Normalizes `n.Normalize()` and returns `new Plane(n, c)`.
- Normal orientation check: if `Vector3.Dot(nrm, prj.normal) < 0f`, flips normal `nrm = -prj.normal` to maintain consistency with vertex winding.
sections.godot_notes: In Godot, PolyShape drawing maps to an `EditorPlugin` tool processing `_forward_3d_gui_input`. Initial plane detection maps to `Camera3D.project_ray_origin` / `project_ray_normal` against collision objects or custom plane math. The discrete 3-stage state machine (Path -> Height -> Edit) maps cleanly to an internal tool enum.

sections.heading: POLYSHAPE EDIT
sections.content:
Editing an existing PolyShape allows moving vertex knots in 2D local space, inserting new points along perimeter edges, deleting selected points, and adjusting extrusion height via center handles.

1. Entering Edit Mode:
- From Inspector (`PolyShapeEditor`), clicking 'Edit Poly Shape' activates `ToolManager.SetActiveTool<PolyShapeTool>()`.
- From Menu, `Tools/ProBuilder/Edit/Edit PolyShape` activates `PolyShapeTool` if any selected GameObject contains a `PolyShape` component.
- Method `UpdateTarget()` sets `polygon = psComp` and executes `SetPolyEditMode(PolyShape.PolyEditMode.Edit)`.
- When transitioning from `PolyEditMode.None` to `PolyEditMode.Edit` with `m_Points.Count > 2`, `SetPolyEditMode` clears element selection in `ProBuilderEditor` and registers undo state via `Undo.RegisterCompleteObjectUndo(polygon, "Edit Polygon Shape")` and `Undo.RegisterCompleteObjectUndo(polygon.mesh, "Edit Polygon Shape mesh")`.

2. Moving Existing Points (`DoExistingPointsGUI` in Edit Mode):
- Iterates through all control points `polygon.m_Points` (count `len`).
- Converts each local coordinate to world space `point = trs.TransformPoint(polygon.m_Points[ii])`.
- Calculates handle size `size = HandleUtility.GetHandleSize(point) * k_HandleSize` (where `k_HandleSize = 0.05f`).
- Allocates unique control ID `id = GUIUtility.GetControlID(FocusType.Passive)`. If `ii == 0`, records `m_ControlId0 = id`.
- Sets handle color: `k_HandleSelectedColor` (`Color(.01f, .8f, .98f, 1f)`) if `ii == m_SelectedIndex || HandleUtility.nearestControl == id`, otherwise `k_HandleColor` (`Color(.8f, .8f, .8f, 1f)`).
- Renders planar manipulation handle: `point = Handles.Slider2D(id, point, up, right, forward, size, Handles.DotHandleCap, Vector2.zero, true)`.
- When dragged (`EditorGUI.EndChangeCheck()`):
  - Records undo: `UndoUtility.RecordObject(polygon, "Move Polygon Shape Point")`.
  - Converts world point to local space via `GetPointInLocalSpace(point)` (applying snapping mask `ProBuilderSnapping.GetSnappingMaskBasedOnNormalVector(plane.normal)` and `EditorSnapping.activeMoveSnapValue` when `polygon.isOnGrid` is true).
  - Updates coordinate `polygon.m_Points[ii] = GetPointInLocalSpace(point)`.
  - Invokes `OnBeginVertexMovement()` (setting `m_IsModifyingVertices = true`) and rebuilds mesh via `RebuildPolyShapeMesh(false)`.

3. Inserting Points Along Perimeter Edges (`DoPointPlacement` in `PolyEditMode.Edit`):
- Validates minimum point count: if `polygon.m_Points.Count < 3`, automatically sets `SetPolyEditMode(PolyShape.PolyEditMode.Path)`.
- Verifies cursor distance from height handle exceeds threshold `m_DistanceFromHeightHandle > PreferenceKeys.k_MaxPointDistanceFromControl` (10 pixels).
- Raycasts mouse ray against `plane` to obtain hit point `point = GetPointInLocalSpace(hit)`.
- Calls `EditorHandleUtility.ClosestPointToPolyLine(polygon.m_Points, out index, out distToLineInGUI, true, polygon.transform)`.
- Computes segment interpolation ratio along edge segment between vertex `index - 1` and `index % polyCount`:
  `Vector3 aToPoint = point - polygon.m_Points[index - 1]`
  `Vector3 aToB = polygon.m_Points[index % polyCount] - polygon.m_Points[index - 1]`
  `float ratio = Vector3.Dot(aToPoint, aToB.normalized) / aToB.magnitude`
  `Vector3 wp = polygon.transform.TransformPoint(Vector3.Lerp(polygon.m_Points[index - 1], polygon.m_Points[index % polyCount], ratio))`.
- Validates insertion criteria: checks that GUI distance to endpoints `distanceToVertex > PreferenceKeys.k_MaxPointDistanceFromControl` and distance to edge line `distToLineInGUI < PreferenceKeys.k_MaxPointDistanceFromControl`.
- Visual feedback: sets cursor `m_MouseCursor = MouseCursor.ArrowPlus` and renders green dot handle `Handles.DotHandleCap(-1, wp, Quaternion.identity, HandleUtility.GetHandleSize(wp) * k_HandleSize, evt.type)` with `Handles.color = Color.green`.
- Insertion execution on `EventType.MouseDown` (button 0):
  - Records undo: `UndoUtility.RecordObject(polygon, "Insert Point")`.
  - Inserts point into list: `polygon.m_Points.Insert(index, point)`.
  - Updates state: `m_SelectedIndex = index`, `m_PlacingPoint = true`, triggers `RebuildPolyShapeMesh(true)` and `OnBeginVertexMovement()`.

4. Deleting Points & Keyboard Navigation (`HandleKeyEvent`):
- Key `KeyCode.Backspace` (macOS Delete): if `m_SelectedIndex > -1`, records undo `UndoUtility.RecordObject(polygon, "Delete Selected Points")`, deletes vertex `polygon.m_Points.RemoveAt(m_SelectedIndex)`, resets `m_SelectedIndex = -1`, rebuilds mesh `RebuildPolyShapeMesh(polygon)`, and consumes event `evt.Use()`.
- Key `KeyCode.Space` or `KeyCode.Return`: finalizes edit mode and exits tool via `LeaveTool()`.
- Key `KeyCode.Escape`: aborts editing and restores previous persistent tool via `LeaveTool()`.

5. Height Handle in Edit Mode (`DoExistingPointsGUI`):
- Computes average center `center = average(polygon.m_Points)` in world space.
- Computes top extrusion handle position `extrude = center + (up * polygon.extrude)`.
- Records GUI distance `m_DistanceFromHeightHandle = Vector2.Distance(HandleUtility.WorldToGUIPoint(extrude), evt.mousePosition)`.
- When `m_DrawHeightHandles == true`: draws base dot at `center` (`k_HandleColor`), vertical line `Handles.DrawLine(center, extrude)`, and 1D slider handle along `up` axis `extrude = Handles.Slider(extrude, up, HandleUtility.GetHandleSize(extrude) * k_HandleSize, Handles.DotHandleCap, 0f)` in green (`k_HandleColorGreen`).
- When dragged: records undo `UndoUtility.RecordObject(polygon, "Set Polygon Shape Height")`, updates `polygon.extrude = EditorSnapping.MoveSnap(Vector3.Distance(extrude, center) * Mathf.Sign(Vector3.Dot(up, extrude - center)))`, invokes `OnBeginVertexMovement()`, and calls `RebuildPolyShapeMesh(false)`.
sections.godot_notes: Point editing maps to Godot's `EditorNode3DGizmoPlugin` with subgizmo manipulation. Vertex dot handles correspond to subgizmo IDs, and edge hover insertion corresponds to subgizmo hover tests calculating segment projection via `Geometry3D.get_closest_point_to_segment`.

sections.heading: POLYSHAPE EXTRUSION
sections.content:
The conversion from a 2D polyline path into a solid 3D manifold mesh is executed by `AppendElements.CreateShapeFromPolygon(this ProBuilderMesh mesh, IList<Vector3> points, float extrude, bool flipNormals, IList<IList<Vector3>> holePoints)`.

1. Input Validation & Preparation:
- Verifies `mesh != null`. If `points == null || points.Count < 3`, clears geometry via `ClearAndRefreshMesh(mesh)` and returns `ActionResult(ActionResult.Status.NoChange, "Too Few Points")`.
- Validates optional hole definitions in `holePoints`: if any hole has fewer than 3 points, returns `ActionResult(ActionResult.Status.NoChange, "Too Few Points in hole " + i)`.
- Flattens vertex coordinates: `vertices = points.ToArray()`. If holes exist, concatenates outer vertices and hole vertices into `combinedVertices`.

2. 2D Planar Triangulation (`Triangulation.TriangulateVertices`):
- Invokes `Triangulation.TriangulateVertices(vertices, out triangles, holeVertices)`.
- Validates surface area: checks `Math.PolygonArea(combinedVertices, indexes) >= Mathf.Epsilon`. If area is below epsilon, clears mesh and returns `ActionResult(ActionResult.Status.Failure, "Polygon Area < Epsilon")`.
- Creates base Face: `mesh.positionsInternal = combinedVertices`, `mesh.facesInternal = new[] { new Face(indexes) }`, and builds shared vertex table `mesh.sharedVerticesInternal = SharedVertex.GetSharedVerticesWithPositions(combinedVertices)`.
- Validates vertex inclusion: verifies that all input vertices are referenced in triangulation `newFace.distinctIndexesInternal.Length == combinedVertices.Length`. If any vertices are dropped (indicating self-intersections or degenerate topology), clears mesh and returns `ActionResult(ActionResult.Status.Failure, "Triangulation missing points")`.

3. Normal Alignment & `flipNormals` Handling:
- Computes geometric normal of the triangulated base face: `Vector3 nrm = Math.Normal(mesh, mesh.facesInternal[0])`, and transforms it to world space: `nrm = mesh.gameObject.transform.TransformDirection(nrm)`.
- Compares against local GameObject up vector `mesh.gameObject.transform.up`:
  `if ((flipNormals ? Vector3.Dot(mesh.gameObject.transform.up, nrm) > 0f : Vector3.Dot(mesh.gameObject.transform.up, nrm) < 0f))`
  `    mesh.facesInternal[0].Reverse();`
- Behavior: when `flipNormals == false`, base cap normal is oriented to point opposite to `transform.up` (facing downwards as the bottom cap). When `flipNormals == true`, the winding is inverted so the base faces upwards (interior orientation).

4. 3D Volume Extrusion Algorithm:
- If `extrude == 0.0f`: mesh remains a 2D planar face (1 face).
- If `extrude != 0.0f`:
  1. Duplicates and flips the base face: `mesh.DuplicateAndFlip(mesh.facesInternal)`. This produces face 0 (bottom cap) and face 1 (top cap, facing in reverse direction).
  2. Extrudes the target cap face: selects cap `(flipNormals ? mesh.facesInternal[1] : mesh.facesInternal[0])` and executes `mesh.Extrude(new Face[] { targetCap }, ExtrudeMethod.IndividualFaces, extrude)`.
  3. `Extrude` translates the vertices of the selected cap along its normal by distance `extrude`, automatically generating quad side faces bridging corresponding perimeter edges.
  4. Parity winding inversion: checks `if ((extrude < 0f && !flipNormals) || (extrude > 0f && flipNormals))` and calls `face.Reverse()` on every face in `mesh.facesInternal` to preserve correct outward/inward facing winding under negative heights or inverted normals.
- Calls `mesh.ToMesh()` and `mesh.Refresh()` to rebuild Unity Mesh buffers, computing normals, tangents, and UVs.

5. Error Handling & Visual Fallback:
- If `CreateShapeFromPolygon` returns `ActionResult.Status.Failure` (e.g. self-intersecting polygon path), `PolyShapeTool.RebuildPolyShapeMesh` sets line color `m_CurrentLineColor = k_InvalidLineColor` (`Color.red`), disables height handle rendering `m_DrawHeightHandles = false`, and transitions edit mode out of Height to `PolyShape.PolyEditMode.Edit`.
sections.godot_notes: In Godot, 2D polygon triangulation is available via `Geometry2D.triangulate_polygon` or `Geometry2D.triangulate_delaunay`. Extrusion can generate top and bottom caps with `ArrayMesh` surfaces, connecting corresponding perimeter vertices into quad strips with `Vector3` normals calculated per face.

sections.heading: BEZIER SHAPE
sections.content:
The BezierShape subsystem provides 3D pipe and tube mesh generation by tessellating a 3D spline of Bezier knots and sweeping circular cross-section vertex rings along the curve path. Implemented in runtime classes `BezierShape`, `BezierPoint`, `Spline`, and editor `BezierShapeEditor`.

1. Component Architecture & Data Model:
- Class `BezierShape : MonoBehaviour`: decorated with `[AddComponentMenu("")]`, `[DisallowMultipleComponent, ExcludeFromPreset, ExcludeFromObjectFactory]`, and `[RequireComponent(typeof(ProBuilderMesh))]`.
- Fields and properties: `points` (`List<BezierPoint>`), `closeLoop` (`bool`, default `false`), `radius` (`float`, default `0.5f`, minimum `0.001f`), `rows` (`int`, default `8`, range `[3, 512]`), `columns` (`int`, default `16`, range `[3, 512]`), `smooth` (`bool`, default `true`), and `isEditing` (`bool`). Property `mesh` provides lazy retrieval and initialization of `ProBuilderMesh`.
- Struct `BezierPoint`: serialized value type representing a knot:
  - Fields: `position` (`Vector3`), `tangentIn` (`Vector3`), `tangentOut` (`Vector3`), `rotation` (`Quaternion`).
  - Constructor: `BezierPoint(Vector3 position, Vector3 tangentIn, Vector3 tangentOut, Quaternion rotation)`.

2. Tangent Handle Modes (`BezierTangentMode` & `BezierTangentDirection`):
- Enums `BezierTangentMode { Free, Aligned, Mirrored }` and `BezierTangentDirection { In, Out }`.
- Method `EnforceTangentMode(BezierTangentDirection master, BezierTangentMode mode)` enforces geometric constraints:
  - `Free`: no handle linking. Moving one tangent leaves the opposite untouched.
  - `Aligned`: maintains collinearity while preserving individual tangent lengths. If `master == In`, sets `tangentOut = position + (tangentOut - position).normalized * (tangentIn - position).magnitude`; if `master == Out`, sets `tangentIn = position + (tangentIn - position).normalized * (tangentOut - position).magnitude`.
  - `Mirrored`: locks tangent handles in exact opposite collinear directions of identical magnitude. If `master == In`, sets `tangentOut = position - (tangentIn - position)`; if `master == Out`, sets `tangentIn = position - (tangentOut - position)`.

3. Default Initialization (`BezierShape.Init()`):
- Initial knot set: adds 2 default control points:
  - Knot 0 at `Vector3.zero` with `tangentIn = (0f, 0f, -2f)`, `tangentOut = (0f, 0f, 2f)`, and `rotation = Quaternion.identity`.
  - Knot 1 at `(3f, 0f, 0f)` with `tangentIn = (3f, 0f, 2f)`, `tangentOut = (3f, 0f, -2f)`, and `rotation = Quaternion.identity`.

4. Spline Tessellation (`Spline.GetControlPoints`):
- Converts discrete Bezier knots into dense interpolated centerline positions and orientations.
- Segment subdivision count `columns` (`subdivisionsPerSegment`): keyframe count is `c` if `closeLoop` else `c - 1` (where `c = bezierPoints.Count`).
- Evaluates cubic Bernstein polynomial via `BezierPoint.CubicPosition(BezierPoint a, BezierPoint b, float t)`:
  `t = Mathf.Clamp01(t); float oneMinusT = 1f - t;`
  `return oneMinusT * oneMinusT * oneMinusT * a.position + 3f * oneMinusT * oneMinusT * t * a.tangentOut + 3f * oneMinusT * t * t * b.tangentIn + t * t * t * b.position;`
- Rotation interpolation: evaluates `Quaternion.Slerp(bezierPoints[i].rotation, bezierPoints[(i + 1) % c].rotation, n / (float)(segments_per_keyframe - 1))`.

5. 3D Surface Sweeping Algorithm (`Spline.Extrude`):
- Extrudes cylindrical tube mesh from tessellated centerline points `points`:
  - Number of circular segments: `int rows = System.Math.Max(3, radiusRows)`. Sets `rowsPlus1 = rows + 1` and `rowsPlus1Times2 = rows * 2`.
  - Total vertex allocation: `vertexCount = ((closeLoop ? cnt : cnt - 1) * 2) * rowsPlus1Times2`.
  - Face allocation: `faceCount = (closeLoop ? cnt : cnt - 1) * rows`.
- Ring Orientation & Miter Evaluation (`GetRingRotation`):
  - For interior or closed-loop points: computes incoming direction `coming = (points[b] - points[a]).normalized` and outgoing direction `leaving = (points[c] - points[b]).normalized`.
  - Average tangent direction: `dir = ((coming + leaving) * .5f).normalized`.
  - Miter factor: `secant = Math.Secant(Vector3.Angle(coming, dir) * Mathf.Deg2Rad)`.
  - Returns `Quaternion.LookRotation(dir)`.
  - Point rotation combining: `rotation_a = rotation_a * pointRotations[i]`.
- Ring Vertex Generation (`VertexRing`):
  - Sweeps circle around orientation frame: for `i` from `0` to `segments - 1` (where `segments = rows + 1`):
    `float rad0 = (i / (float)(segments - 1)) * 360f * Mathf.Deg2Rad;`
    `int n = (i + 1) % segments;`
    `float rad1 = (n / (float)(segments - 1)) * 360f * Mathf.Deg2Rad;`
    `v[i * 2] = offset + (orientation * new Vector3(Mathf.Cos(rad0) * radius, Mathf.Sin(rad0) * radius, 0f));`
    `v[i * 2 + 1] = offset + (orientation * new Vector3(Mathf.Cos(rad1) * radius, Mathf.Sin(rad1) * radius, 0f));`
- Quad Face Construction:
  - Connects Ring A and Ring B vertices: for `n = 0` to `rowsPlus1Times2 - 2` step 2:
    `faces[faceIndex] = new Face(new int[6] { triangleIndex, triangleIndex + 1, triangleIndex + rowsPlus1Times2, triangleIndex + rowsPlus1Times2, triangleIndex + 1, triangleIndex + rowsPlus1Times2 + 1 });`
  - Soft normals: if `smooth == true`, assigns `faces[faceIndex].smoothingGroup = 2`.
  - Advances `faceIndex++` and `triangleIndex += 2`.
- Mesh Construction: calls `target.RebuildWithPositionsAndFaces(positions, faces)` to populate ProBuilderMesh buffers.
sections.godot_notes: In Godot, `Curve3D` provides cubic Bezier evaluation and baked point extraction. Spline extrusion can sweep a circular polygon along `Curve3D.get_baked_points()` using Frenet-Serret frames or parallel transport frames to generate an `ArrayMesh` tube.

sections.heading: BEZIER EDITING
sections.content:
Interactive editing of Bezier shapes is managed by `BezierShapeEditor : Editor`, which provides SceneView handles for knot positions, tangent handles, axial rotation, and interactive point insertion/deletion.

1. Handle Selection & Internal State (`BezierHandle`):
- Struct `BezierHandle`: serialized handle identifier containing `int index`, `bool isTangent`, and `BezierTangentDirection tangent` (`In` or `Out`). Includes implicit conversions to/from integer index and tangent direction.
- Active handle stored in `m_currentHandle = new BezierHandle(-1, false)`.
- Tangent mode toolbar in Inspector toggles `m_TangentMode` (`Free`, `Aligned`, `Mirrored`) with custom icons `s_TangentModeIcons`.
- Spline curve visualization: `Handles.DrawBezier(m_Points[index].position, m_Points[(index + 1) % count].position, m_Points[index].tangentOut, m_Points[(index + 1) % count].tangentIn, Color.green, EditorGUIUtility.whiteTexture, 1f)`.

2. Moving Knots vs Tangent Handles (`OnSceneGUI`):
- When knot is selected (`m_currentHandle == index && !m_currentHandle.isTangent`):
  - Position Handle: renders 3D translation gizmo `prev = Handles.PositionHandle(prev, Quaternion.identity)`.
  - Rigid Tangent Translation: when knot position moves by delta `dir = prev - point.position`, translates both tangents simultaneously: `point.position = prev; point.tangentIn += dir; point.tangentOut += dir;`.
  - Axial Spline Rotation: computes look direction `Vector3 rd = BezierPoint.GetLookDirection(m_Points, index, prev_index, next_index)` where `prev_index` and `next_index` account for `m_CloseLoop`. Sets handle matrix `Handles.matrix = pm * Matrix4x4.TRS(point.position, Quaternion.LookRotation(rd), Vector3.one)` and renders rotation disc `point.rotation = Handles.Disc(point.rotation, Vector3.zero, Vector3.forward, size, false, 0f)`.
- When tangent handle is selected (`m_currentHandle == index && m_currentHandle.isTangent`):
  - Tangent In: renders `Handles.PositionHandle(point.tangentIn, Quaternion.identity)`. Dragging snaps via `EditorSnapping.MoveSnap` and enforces tangent mode: `point.EnforceTangentMode(BezierTangentDirection.In, m_TangentMode)`. Draws blue line `Handles.DrawLine(point.position, point.tangentIn)`.
  - Tangent Out: renders `Handles.PositionHandle(point.tangentOut, Quaternion.identity)`. Dragging snaps via `EditorSnapping.MoveSnap` and enforces tangent mode: `point.EnforceTangentMode(BezierTangentDirection.Out, m_TangentMode)`. Draws red line `Handles.DrawLine(point.position, point.tangentOut)`.
- Unselected Knots & Tangents: rendered with `FreeMoveHandle` using `Handles.DotHandleCap` (`bezierPositionHandleColor = Color(.01f, .8f, .99f, 1f)` for knots, `bezierTangentHandleColor = Color(.6f, .6f, .6f, .8f)` for tangents). Clicking any unselected handle selects it and sets `m_currentHandle`.

3. Inserting Control Points Along Spline Curve (`OnSceneGUI`):
- Real-time mouse hover test against dense interpolated control points `m_ControlPoints`:
  `Vector3 p = EditorHandleUtility.ClosestPointToPolyLine(m_ControlPoints, out index, out distanceToLine, false, null);`
- Validates hover: checks `!IsHoveringHandlePoint(e.mousePosition)` (distance to existing knot/tangent GUI points >= `k_MaxPointDistanceFromControl`) and `distanceToLine < PreferenceKeys.k_MaxPointDistanceFromControl` (10 pixels).
- Visual feedback: draws green dot handle `Handles.DotHandleCap(-1, p, Quaternion.identity, HandleUtility.GetHandleSize(p) * .05f, e.type)`.
- Insertion on click (`EventType.MouseDown` with `button == 0`):
  - Records undo: `UndoUtility.RecordObject(m_Target, "Add Point")`.
  - Computes tangent direction from neighbouring interpolated points: `dir = m_ControlPoints[(index + 1) % count] - m_ControlPoints[index]`.
  - Computes knot insertion index: `int insertIndex = (index / m_Columns) + 1`.
  - Inserts new knot: `m_Points.Insert(insertIndex, new BezierPoint(p, p - dir, p + dir, Quaternion.identity))`.
  - Rebuilds geometry via `UpdateMesh(true)`.

4. Adding and Deleting Control Points via UI & Keyboard:
- Inspector 'Add Point' Button: appends duplicate of last knot `m_Points.Add(new BezierPoint(last.position, last.tangentIn, last.tangentOut, Quaternion.identity))` or calls `m_Target.Init()` if empty, setting `m_currentHandle = (BezierHandle)(m_Points.Count - 1)`.
- Inspector 'Clear Points' Button: records undo and clears all knots via `m_Points.Clear()`, calling `UpdateMesh(true)`.
- Keyboard Deletion: pressing `KeyCode.Backspace` (macOS Delete) in SceneView with valid `m_currentHandle` records undo `UndoUtility.RecordObject(m_Target, "Delete Bezier Point")`, deletes knot `m_Points.RemoveAt(m_currentHandle)`, and updates mesh.
- Inspector Coordinate Editing (`DoBezierPointGUI`): displays Vector3 fields for `Position`, `Tan. In` (annotated with blue dot label), `Tan. Out` (annotated with red dot label), and Euler `Rotation`. Modifications invoke `SetPosition`, `SetTangentIn`, and `SetTangentOut` with `m_TangentMode`.

5. Vertex Modification Lifecycle & Lightmapping Optimization:
- When handle dragging begins, `OnBeginVertexModification()` sets `m_IsMoving = true`, records undo `"Modify Bezier Spline"`, and pauses continuous lightmapping via `Lightmapping.PushGIWorkflowMode()`.
- When dragging ends (`EventType.MouseUp` or `EventType.Ignore`), `OnFinishVertexModification()` sets `m_IsMoving = false`, restores GI via `Lightmapping.PopGIWorkflowMode()`, optimizes ProBuilderMesh via `m_CurrentObject.Optimize()`, and refreshes editor via `ProBuilderEditor.Refresh()`.
sections.godot_notes: In Godot, Path3D gizmo editing provides similar handle interactions for in/out tangents. A custom `EditorNode3DGizmoPlugin` can render Position handles and rotation discs, with tangent mirroring matching `Path3D` handle editing modes.
